irc.amendments: Alabama Residential Building Code (2015 IRC, state amended)

elsewhere: Residential code is mandatory statewide but enforced locally; many rural counties do not enforce. Authority moved to the Alabama Home Builders Licensure Board (Oct 1, 2024, Act 2024-443), which was to adopt a residential code by Oct 2025.
